playedSec.description: From kickoff to the end of the period, including added time; time play was suspended is left out (TMR-13). With a stopping clock (TMR-15), the clock's time, so the period's length.

stoppedSec.description: With a stopping clock (TMR-15), how long the clock stood still in the period (its stoppages): the period ran for playedSec plus this, and any suspensions.

suspended.description: When play was suspended in the period and resumed (TMR-13), on the clock of day from startedAt: the period ran for playedSec plus these. The track's figures leave them out (TRK-3).

fromSec.description: Seconds of wall-clock time after startedAt.
